name: Crude Oil EIA Inventory Report Reaction
description: Measures how crude oil (CL) moves around the weekly EIA petroleum inventory report released Wednesdays at 10:30 ET. Uses 1-min bars to compute average absolute price moves at 1, 5, 15, and 30 minutes after the release. Event detection via Wednesday + 10:30 ET time proxy (~5% error from holiday-shifted releases).
source:
# Crude Oil EIA Inventory Report Reaction Study
# EIA Petroleum Status Report: Wednesdays at 10:30 ET
# Measures absolute price moves at 1, 5, 15, 30 minutes post-release

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c

# --- EIA Release Detection ---
# EIA Petroleum reports release Wednesdays at 10:30 ET
# Use day_of_week + session_window to detect the exact bar
is_wed = day_of_week(weekday=Weekday.Wednesday)()
is_wed_flag = is_wed.result

# Session window from 10:30-10:31 ET — .opened fires on the 10:30 bar
eia_window = session_window(
    session=Session(start='10:30', end='10:31', tz='America/New_York')
)(cont.o, cont.h, cont.l, cont.c)

# EIA release bar: Wednesday AND the 10:30 ET bar opens
is_eia_bar = is_wed_flag and eia_window.opened

# --- Forward Absolute Moves (% terms) ---
# Lead operator on 1Min bars: << 1 = +1 min, << 5 = +5 min, etc.
abs_move_1m = abs((close << 1) / close - 1.0)
abs_move_5m = abs((close << 5) / close - 1.0)
abs_move_15m = abs((close << 15) / close - 1.0)
abs_move_30m = abs((close << 30) / close - 1.0)

# Filter to EIA release bars only (sparse)
eia_abs_1m = where(is_eia_bar, abs_move_1m)
eia_abs_5m = where(is_eia_bar, abs_move_5m)
eia_abs_15m = where(is_eia_bar, abs_move_15m)
eia_abs_30m = where(is_eia_bar, abs_move_30m)

# Signed move for event marker context (direction matters for cards)
signed_move_30m = where(is_eia_bar, (close << 30) / close - 1.0)
signed_move_5m = where(is_eia_bar, (close << 5) / close - 1.0)
price_at_release = where(is_eia_bar, close)

# --- Year extraction for heatmap / grouping ---
ts = index()
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)

# --- Output 1: Bar Chart — Average Absolute Move by Horizon ---
# The punchline: how big is the typical EIA reaction at each time horizon?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='How Big Is the Typical EIA Reaction?',
    category='EIA Reaction',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg Absolute Move',
    x_axis_label='Minutes After Release',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=False,
    order=1,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 min', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+15 min', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+30 min', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ])
)(values=(eia_abs_1m, eia_abs_5m, eia_abs_15m, eia_abs_30m))

# --- Output 2: Summary Table — Key Stats per Horizon ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='EIA Reaction',
    order=2,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='EIA Release Reaction Stats (Absolute Moves)',
        row_size=4, col_size=4,
        row_headers=['+1 min', '+5 min', '+15 min', '+30 min'],
        col_headers=['Events (N)', 'Median', 'Mean', 'Max'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(eia_abs_1m, eia_abs_1m, eia_abs_1m, eia_abs_1m,
  eia_abs_5m, eia_abs_5m, eia_abs_5m, eia_abs_5m,
  eia_abs_15m, eia_abs_15m, eia_abs_15m, eia_abs_15m,
  eia_abs_30m, eia_abs_30m, eia_abs_30m, eia_abs_30m)

# --- Output 3: Event Markers — Each EIA Release ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='EIA Inventory Release',
        icon=Icon.ZapIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='30-Min Move', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='5-Min Move', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='CL Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(signed_move_30m, signed_move_5m, price_at_release, is_eia_bar)
